import math

A = (4, 0)
B = (0, 3)

# Calculate the area using the shoelace formula
area = abs((A[0]*B[1] + B[0]*C[1] + C[0]*A[1]) - (A[1]*B[0] + B[1]*C[0] + C[1]*A[0])) / 2

# Calculate the point Q that divides the area in half

# Print the points
print([[p_perimeter_x, p_perimeter_y], [q_area_x, q_area_y]])
